module "PropertyCallExpansion.dsm"

product 0 Material "M_LiPropertyCall" backend=Graph
  legacy root ""
  %0 = Constant(Value=(1, 0.5, 0)) : float3 @L17:C32 "Color"
  %1 = Constant(Value=(0, 0.5, 1)) : float3 @L17:C61 "Color"
  %2 = Reflected[StaticSwitchParameter](A=%0, B=%1, ClassSpecifier="StaticSwitchParameter", DefaultValue=true, ParameterName="UseWarm") : float3 @L17:C17 "Color"
  %3 = Constant(Value=(1)) : float @L18:C32 "Alpha"
  %4 = Constant(Value=(0.5)) : float @L18:C45 "Alpha"
  %5 = Reflected[StaticSwitchParameter](A=%3, B=%4, ClassSpecifier="StaticSwitchParameter", DefaultValue=true, ParameterName="UseWarm") : float @L18:C17 "Alpha"
  %6 = MaterialSink(EmissiveColor=%2, Opacity=%5) @L3:C1
  sink %6
